Class LayoutValue

Namespace: osu.Framework.Layout
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A member that represents the validation state of the layout of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. Can be invalidated according to state changes in a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable (via osu.Framework.Graphics.Invalidation flags), and validated on-demand when the layout has been re-computed.
